what: Each letter starts hidden with 20px blur and 20px below, transparent, then sharpens from the front one by one at .048s intervals over .6s ease, as if ink were soaking into paper — the Hero tagline. The 20px size is for a 1440 screen, so it scales with screen width (min(1.389vw, 20px)), and the second line is delayed with delay (original 1.4s), so each line is set up separately

options.delay: Start delay (s), default .5 — second line is original 1.9 (.5 + 1.4)
options.dur: Duration of one character taking shape (sec), default .6
options.blur: Initial blur (px), default 20 — scales with screen width (this value at 1440)
options.rise: Initial downward offset (px), default 20 — scales with screen width
options.ease: Curve (four cubic-bezier numbers or a GSAP name), default ease(0.25,0.1,0.25,1)
options.on: ‹view› means when it enters 85% of the screen, not right on attach · ‹state› means only via the fx:play event
options.start: ScrollTrigger start for on: view, default top 85% — one original site uses top 80% (IntersectionObserver rootMargin bottom −20%)
options.size: If fixed, blur and rise are not scaled to screen width but stay in px (Brand title blur 6px)
options.fx:play: Send this event and it turns on right away
